limitations: Partial scope: the 36 pulse-chase SILAC runs (Fig 3F/3G; 201119_Daniella_DH-1445_01..36.raw, Orbitrap Eclipse targeted method "Dani Target.meth") are NOT annotated. Their MaxQuant experiments are named only 01..36, and the per-run design (cell line, pulse/chase time point, IP vs input, replicate) is described only in the PNAS 2021 paper, whose full text, figure legends and SI are not retrievable (PMC body not open access; Europe PMC fullTextXML HTTP 500; pnas.org and pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov served bot checks, not bypassed; Unpaywall only points to the bioRxiv v1 preprint, which predates the pulse-chase experiment). Recorded in annotations/BLOCKED.md.

Full PNAS text not available; methods come from bioRxiv v1 (10.1101/2020.09.18.303255), the PRIDE protocols, MaxQuant outputs and raw headers. The preprint says the instrument was an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos; the raw headers (authoritative) show Q Exactive Plus (SILAC) and Orbitrap Elite (AE-MS).
